subject: Columbus School Renaming Advisory Committee Selection
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to select the 23 voting members of the Columbus School Renaming Advisory Committee. The body established the committee's composition through a combination of individual appointments, a random lottery, and designated staff and student roles.

items.title: Selection Process and Rules
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn read the policy outlining the selection process for the 23-member advisory committee and its mandate to submit name finalists by May 24, 2021.

items.title: Appointment of Chair
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn appointed applicant Jim Lister to serve as the chair of the advisory committee.

items.title: Member Selections by Lottery and Appointment
items.summary: The committee selected three members via a random lottery and 14 members through individual selections made by school committee members and the mayor. Selected members include Laura Rotolo, Ronald Giovino, Maria Rocha, Grace Caldera, Paul Donato Jr., Brie Brothers, Ken Mallon, Erin Genia, Beth Fuller, Melissa Miguel, Seth Hill, Lou Intoppa, Henrik Gideons, Pat McCabe, Leroy LaFleur, Kristen Scalise, and Dan Puccio.

items.title: Rejection of Alternate Members
items.summary: The committee declined to select alternate members, maintaining that the established policy does not permit backfilling vacancies.

items.title: Confirmation of Staff and Student Representatives
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent announced the designated appointments of Principal Kathy Kaye, staff members Matthew Havistraw, Kaitlin Shaughnessy, and Janelle Gollin-McKenzie, and student representative Josie DeFore.
